text: だれに　なに　いうても　ぜんぜん　つうじへんし　はずかしゅうて　じむしょも　かお　だせへん　かったんや　そや　じょーちゃん！

structure.jp: だれに　なに　いうても
structure.en: no matter what I said to anyone

structure.jp: ぜんぜん　つうじへんし
じむしょも　かお　だせへん　かったんや
structure.en: I couldn't even show my face at the office

structure.jp: そや　じょーちゃん！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A question word followed by a verb with ても means 'no matter'. いうて is the Kansai way of saying いって. なに　いうても = 'no matter what I said'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: へん is the Kansai-dialect ない, which turns a verb into 'not'. つうじへん = 'doesn't get through'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んや is the Kansai form of のだ, which shows the speaker is explaining how things were. だせへん　かったんや = 'the thing is, I couldn't show it'.
